#[cfg(test)]
mod golden_writer {
    //! Throwaway: writes the v0.32 (c1dfa872) text-to-image forward's outputs
    //! for `qwen_image21/transformer.rs`'s committed legacy golden.
    use super::*;
    use std::collections::HashMap;

    fn config(heads: usize) -> QwenImage21TransformerConfig {
        QwenImage21TransformerConfig {
            in_channels: 4,
            out_channels: 4,
            context_in_dim: 8,
            num_attention_heads: heads,
            attention_head_dim: 8,
            num_layers: 3,
            mlp_ratio: 2,
            axes_dims_rope: [2, 2, 4],
            eps: 1e-6,
        }
    }

    fn shapes(cfg: &QwenImage21TransformerConfig) -> Vec<(String, Vec<usize>)> {
        let inner = cfg.inner_dim();
        let mut out = vec![
            ("img_in.weight".to_string(), vec![inner, cfg.in_channels]),
            (
                "time_text_embed.timestep_embedder.linear_1.weight".into(),
                vec![inner, 256],
            ),
            (
                "time_text_embed.timestep_embedder.linear_2.weight".into(),
                vec![inner, inner],
            ),
            ("txt_in.text_norm.weight".into(), vec![cfg.context_in_dim]),
            (
                "txt_in.in_layer.weight".into(),
                vec![inner, cfg.context_in_dim],
            ),
            ("txt_in.out_layer.weight".into(), vec![inner, inner]),
            ("modulation.1.weight".into(), vec![4 * inner, inner]),
            ("norm_out.linear.weight".into(), vec![inner, inner]),
            ("proj_out.weight".into(), vec![cfg.out_channels, inner]),
        ];
        for index in 0..cfg.num_layers {
            let p = format!("transformer_blocks.{index}");
            out.push((
                format!("{p}.attn.norm_q.weight"),
                vec![cfg.attention_head_dim],
            ));
            out.push((
                format!("{p}.attn.norm_k.weight"),
                vec![cfg.attention_head_dim],
            ));
            for name in ["to_q", "to_k", "to_v"] {
                out.push((format!("{p}.attn.{name}.weight"), vec![inner, inner]));
            }
            out.push((format!("{p}.attn.to_out.0.weight"), vec![inner, inner]));
            out.push((
                format!("{p}.img_mlp.proj.weight"),
                vec![inner * cfg.mlp_ratio, inner],
            ));
            out.push((
                format!("{p}.img_mlp.gate_layer.weight"),
                vec![inner * cfg.mlp_ratio, inner],
            ));
            out.push((
                format!("{p}.img_mlp.out.weight"),
                vec![inner, inner * cfg.mlp_ratio],
            ));
        }
        out
    }

    #[test]
    #[ignore]
    fn write_legacy_golden() {
        let out = std::env::var("QWEN21_LEGACY_GOLDEN").expect("QWEN21_LEGACY_GOLDEN");
        let cpu = Device::Cpu;
        let mut saved: HashMap<String, Tensor> = HashMap::new();
        // Conditioning: batch 2 with two padding rows on row 0, and batch 1.
        let length = 5usize;
        let conds = vec![
            (
                crate::engine::seeded_randn(41, &[2, length, 8], &cpu, DType::F32).unwrap(),
                vec![
                    (0..length).map(|i| i + 2 < length).collect::<Vec<bool>>(),
                    vec![true; length],
                ],
            ),
            (
                crate::engine::seeded_randn(42, &[1, length, 8], &cpu, DType::F32).unwrap(),
                vec![vec![true; length]],
            ),
        ];
        for (ci, (emb, valid)) in conds.iter().enumerate() {
            saved.insert(format!("cond{ci}.embeddings"), emb.clone());
            let mask: Vec<u8> = valid.iter().flatten().map(|v| u8::from(*v)).collect();
            saved.insert(
                format!("cond{ci}.valid"),
                Tensor::from_vec(mask, (valid.len(), length), &cpu).unwrap(),
            );
        }
        let mut seed = 1000u64;
        for heads in [1usize, 2] {
            let cfg = config(heads);
            let mut weights = HashMap::new();
            for (name, shape) in shapes(&cfg) {
                seed += 1;
                let w = (crate::engine::seeded_randn(seed, &shape, &cpu, DType::F32).unwrap()
                    * 0.2)
                    .unwrap();
                saved.insert(format!("h{heads}.weight.{name}"), w.clone());
                weights.insert(name, w);
            }
            for dtype in [DType::F32, DType::F16] {
                let vb = VarBuilder::from_tensors(weights.clone(), dtype, &cpu);
                let transformer =
                    QwenImage21Transformer::from_var_builder(config(heads), vb).unwrap();
                for (ci, (emb, valid)) in conds.iter().enumerate() {
                    let conditioning = QwenImage21TextConditioning {
                        embeddings: emb.to_dtype(dtype).unwrap(),
                        valid_tokens: valid.clone(),
                    };
                    let batch = valid.len();
                    let mut branch = transformer.prepare_t2i(&conditioning, 2, 4);
                    for (step, time) in [1.0f64, 0.6, 0.2].into_iter().enumerate() {
                        let latents = crate::engine::seeded_randn(
                            50 + step as u64,
                            &[batch, 8, 4],
                            &cpu,
                            dtype,
                        )
                        .unwrap();
                        let uncached = transformer
                            .forward_with_cache(
                                &latents,
                                time,
                                &conditioning,
                                2,
                                4,
                                PrefixCache::Disabled,
                            )
                            .unwrap();
                        let cached = branch.forward(&latents, time).unwrap();
                        let key = format!("h{heads}.{dtype:?}.c{ci}.s{step}");
                        saved.insert(format!("{key}.latents"), latents);
                        saved.insert(format!("{key}.uncached"), uncached);
                        saved.insert(format!("{key}.cached"), cached);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        candle_core::safetensors::save(&saved, &out).unwrap();
    }
}
